summary: Lower general assignment through a reference-aware operation when the LHS may be a property, proxy, or computed reference.

target.notes: Evaluate the LHS reference (including base and computed key) before the RHS, then evaluate RHS once, SetValue once, and return the assigned RHS value.

caveats: Setters/proxies can run code or throw.
Strict-mode writes to non-writable properties or unresolved references have JS-specific failure behavior.
Local-variable assignments may be lowered natively when scope analysis proves equivalence.

tests.name: edge computed property key evaluated before rhs
tests.input: let log=[]; const o={}; function k(){log.push('key'); return 'x'} function v(){log.push('rhs'); return 1} o[k()]=v(); console.log(log.join(','));
